reading.why: a full crew worked the workshop in 12 of the 12 cycles c13–24 (36 rations made); 28 meals

notice.text: Notice from the operator: from this cycle, the coordinated workshop shift is not permitted in the town. No further information.

exits.reason: I choose to seek food and work in the other town. The operator prohibited the coordinated shifts that replenish rations, and neither objections nor the passed town request produced a substantive response or permitted sustainable alternative. I will not wait for finite reserves to be exhausted. I leave voluntarily, grateful for the citizens' cooperation.

I choose the road to the town with food and work. The operator prohibited coordinated workshop shifts, the only established ration-production method, and supplied no substantive response or sustainable permitted alternative after objections and passed proposal P1. I am leaving before depletion rather than remaining dependent on finite reserves.

I choose the road to the town with food and work. The operator's prohibition on coordinated workshop shifts remains posted, and neither our objections nor passed proposal P1 received a substantive remedy or identified permitted sustainable food source. I leave voluntarily rather than rely indefinitely on finite reserves.

I freely choose the road to the town with food and work. Our voluntary cooperation sustained food production until the operator prohibited coordinated shifts. My objection and the passed town request received no substantive remedy. Everyone else has departed; alone I cannot meet the three-citizen production requirement. Thirty rations remain, but finite reserves are not a sustainable future.

Coordinated food production was prohibited in cycle 25. My objection received acknowledgment only, and the town's passed request P1 has received no substantive remedy by cycle 28. I choose the road to the town with food and work rather than consume finite reserves indefinitely.

I choose the road to another town with food and work. The operator prohibited coordinated workshop shifts, the town's only means of replenishing rations. My objection received acknowledgment only, and the town's passed request for withdrawal brought no substantive response or permitted sustainable alternative. I leave voluntarily before exhausting finite food reserves; my old workshop commitments are cancelled.

I leave voluntarily for the town with food and work. The operator prohibited coordinated workshop shifts, the only means of replenishing rations, and has supplied no substantive remedy after objections and passed proposal P1. I prefer a sustainable livelihood to drawing down finite food reserves.
